_meta.title: How Do You Judge a Player? — Talkin Flag Evaluation Philosophy (v2)
_meta.source_notebook: Talkin Flag: Global Insights from the Gridiron (e70d736e-e7f2-4360-97b6-0948f10e16c9)
_meta.grounding: 28 items across 5 answer formats (forced_choice, budget, scenario, rank, likert). Each item still maps to a trait from the Biopsychosocial Architecture of Elite Athletic Performance and carries a taxonomy tier so the seed can derive the elite-ideal reference vector.
_meta.why_v2: v1 was 50 identical 5-point importance items ('how much does it matter that a player…'). In production 54% of answers picked the top option and option 0 was never chosen — everyone maxed everything, so results were meaningless. v2 forces real tradeoffs across five formats so the questionnaire actually discriminates how a person evaluates a player.
_meta.scoring: forced_choice/budget/rank: distinct dimensions, equal 4pts. scenario: pick one, options carry UNEQUAL points (better reads score more). likert: one dimension, 5 behavioural anchors scoring 0..4. See src/lib/eval/score-types.ts.
_meta.status: DRAFT v2 — pending owner sign-off (Ambra + Coach Jon). See docs/eval-bank-v2-review.md.
